summary: A choice-only shortcut solves three generator profiles, including two of the five delivered batch questions. Two rated source profiles are also missing. Package files were not changed.

source_analysis.skill: Infer two missing additive column operations that zero the nonpivot entries of one row in a 4x4 matrix.
reasoning_steps: Identify the unchanged source column and the row reduced to zeros.
Calculate each missing multiplier using k = -a_ri/a_rp.
Select the correct operation pair and verify the matrix transformation.
invariants: Three additive operations use the same unchanged source column.
One operation is supplied and two are missing.
One radio choice contains the correct operation pair.
Displayed intermediate matrices must follow the stated operations.
permitted_variations: Pivot row and column, supplied operation, multiplier signs and magnitudes, and nonpivot entries.
Distractor relationships and displayed positions may vary; their source-example assignments are not essential constraints.

findings.description: For q-130619, q-130627 and q-130624, four choices share an ordered absolute multiplier pair and one swaps those magnitudes. If the singleton is (u,v), selecting (-v,-u) identifies the correct answer without inspecting either matrix. This also affects two surviving records in the exact runner batch.
findings.reproduction: From evidence_root run: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 /home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/.venv/bin/python reproduce.py --case shortcut. The strict regression fails. Seed 1118318699, profile q-130619 produces coefficient pairs (-3,2), (-3,-2), (2,3), (3,2), (3,-2). Singleton (2,3) predicts correct (-3,-2). Complete delivered record: minimal-shortcut.json.
